title: the peace of small moments - cottage life
en: today i felt the need to cultivate peace in the best way i know how by creating alongside nature and practicing slowness on an earth that grows lavender and golden glows where blue mountains rise above the clouds i think that peace of mind is not only achievable but grows in abundance once we begin to nourish it when some flower beds needed to be cut back i decided to make a flower crown something about it stirs in my heart the memory of a little girl running through the woods with dandelions stuck in her hair i find nothing creates a sense of calm more than connecting with childhood memories that you cherish remembering that there was a time when the world is full of nothing but hope and possibilities and then realizing that things can still be that way my prayer for peace in mind i went to

the labyrinth beside my house and took the walk of life a labyrinth isn't a maze though it may seem to be full of confusing twists and turns however the path will lead you to your destination as you walk you will realize that the purpose of the labyrinth isn't to confuse you but to offer a meditation on life a new perspective challenging you to see beyond the next two steps and recognize the beauty in the big picture it is a dry hot windy day and i was having quite a hard time staying cool so i kept myself busy by recording a little song for you guys it's one of my favorite fiddle tunes i'm not a professional fiddler but i am very excited to share this song even though i myself was aware of the mistakes i made in the recording i knew i had to take a step back and just accept that all i wanted to do was share something that means a lot to me and doing my best at it and i have to be at peace with whatever my best is i don't actually play fiddle that much it's

something that i pick up now and then when i feel the need to be more grounded or connect with nature since i like to go outside and play to the skies and offer up my music in a place where i can be alone yet sometimes i feel like i do have an audience and that nature is appreciating my my mediocre efforts julie
zh: 今天，我觉得需要以我所知道的最好方式培养和平，在一片生长着薰衣草和金色光芒的大地上练习缓慢，那里生长着薰衣草和金色的光芒，蓝山耸立在云层之上我认为，心灵的平静不仅是可以实现的，而且一旦我们开始滋养它，心灵的平静就会变得更加丰富。不仅仅是与您珍视的童年记忆联系起来，记住曾经有一段时间，世界除了希望和可能性之外什么都没有，然后意识到事情仍然可以那样，我为心中的和平祈祷，我去了

我家旁边的迷宫，走在人生的道路上 迷宫不是迷宫，虽然它似乎充满了令人困惑的曲折，但路径会引导你到达目的地，当你行走时，你会意识到迷宫的目的不是让你迷惑，而是提供对生活的沉思，一个新的视角，挑战你超越接下来的两步，认识到大局中的美丽。这是一个干燥炎热的多风天，我很难保持冷静，所以我为你们录制一首小歌，让自己忙起来，这是我最喜欢的小提琴曲子之一，我不是专业的小提琴手，但我很高兴能分享这首歌，尽管我自己也意识到了我在录音中犯的错误，我知道我必须退后一步，接受我想做的就是分享一些对我来说意义重大的东西，并尽我最大的努力，我必须坦然接受我最好的东西，我实际上并没有玩那么多小提琴。
当我觉得需要更加脚踏实地或与大自然联系时，我会时不时地拿起一些东西，因为我喜欢出去，向天空玩耍，在一个我可以独处的地方提供我的音乐，但有时我觉得我确实有一个观众，大自然正在欣赏我平庸的努力朱莉
